text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When you find a bug, the first step is to identify exactly what is going wrong. Try to reproduce the problem so you can see it clearly. Next, use debugging tools such as breakpoints or a debugger to watch your code step by step. A systematic approach helps a lot: check one small part at a time instead of guessing. Logging is also very useful. Adding log messages to your code shows what the program is doing and where it fails. With patience and these strategies, you can find and fix bugs more quickly and with less stress.
